scope: all finite simple host graphs red s-star forest versus two-positive-blue-star forest
lemma: Q→(red s positive stars, blue F(v,g)), red support>=2s+floor(s/rho) where rho=ceil((v+g+1)/2), implies nu(Q)>=s+1. Stable nu=s factorcritical components each require at least Vblue=v+g+2 vertices else colour entire component blue and rest red to avoid both targets; hence each component has matching>=rho, q<=floor(s/rho), N<=threshold, contradict red support after deleting a vertex.
joint_application: normalized blue second residual F(V,1) gives rho=floor((V+3)/2), allowing the existing exact BLUE penalty to imply canonical JOINT sharpness for extra profiles
